[[High Inquisitor]] [[Antinnis Tremayne]] wielded a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] during his time as an [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]]. He used this blade to [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] [[Darrin Arkanian]], [[Corwin Shelvay/Legends|Corwin Shelvay]], and [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]].

==History==
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Tremayne wielded the lightsaber in a training session with fellow Inquisitors, [[Gwellib Ap-Llewff]], [[Halmere]], and [[Lanu Pasiq]]. He ended up summoning their lightsabers and wielding all four blades at once. He later dueled Drake Lo'gaan with his lightsaber aboard a shuttle headed for [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. A duel that he lost.<ref name="EAR">''[[Evasive Action: Recruitment]]''</ref>

[[File:TremayneShelvay.jpg|left|thumb|Tremayne (right) in his duel with Corwin Shelvay (left).]]
In [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Darrin Arkanian freed his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] Corwin Shelvay from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] interrogation. The two attempted to flee Coruscant, however, Tremayne cut the two Jedi off. Darrin Arkanian and Tremayne entered a fast paced duel, however, neither could beat each other and the duel ended in a stalemate. Tremayne then threatened Darrin Arkanian to lay down his [[Darrin Arkanian's lightsaber|weapon]], or Shelvay would [[Death/Legends|die]]. During their duel, [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] had put Shelvay at gun point. Darrin complied, saying he'd come quitely, but only if Shelvay was allowed to go free. Tremayne--seeing through the Jedi's bluff--struck the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] Jedi Master down. He gloated over his victory of killing his first Jedi Master, however, he then noticed that Shelvay had somehow broke free. He felt a stirring in the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] as Shelvay [[Telekinesis/Legends|summoned]] his masters lightsaber before quickly attacking Tremayne. Tremayne held his ground, however, his blade kept being pushed closer and closer to his face. Eventually, Tremayne attempted to a do a feint he had perfected, but in an unpredictable and unorthodox move, Shelvay sliced off Tremayne's right arm and severely damaged the right side of his face.<ref name="DV" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Tremayne's lightsaber was first pictured and mentioned in [[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim|''Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim'']],<ref name="GG9" /> however, it didn't make its first appearance until "[[Dark Vendetta (short story)|Dark Vendetta]]."<ref name="DV" /> Dark Vendetta's main artwork portrays Tremayne duelling Shelvay, however, the lightsaber colors of his lightsaber and Darrin Arkanian's are swapped.<ref name="DV" />
